baseline_models.focus_anchor: The nominal construction فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ joins an act of release to the neck as a metonym for a whole person.
baseline_models.mechanism: The release branch explicitly overlaps pledge, captive, and neck, while the neck branch extends the body part to a person held in bondage. Their intersection names termination of an actual hold over a human being, not merely an inward feeling of relief.

activation_trace.role: Freeing a pledge, captive, or neck from closure supplies the concrete release operation and its juridical force.
The anatomical neck extended to a slave, captive, or whole person supplies the embodied object of release.

changed_reading.before: The phrase could be heard as an unspecified loosening involving a neck.
changed_reading.after: It names the concrete release of a whole embodied person from a relation of bondage.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَكُّ contributes opening and separation, while the root of رَقَبَةٍ also carries watching and guarding.
baseline_models.mechanism: A captive condition is maintained not only by a bond but by an interlaced apparatus of watch, guard, and retention. On this branch pairing, release dismantles the custody mechanism that continually reproduces captivity.

activation_trace.role: Opening what is locked and separating what is interlaced supplies the dismantling action.
Watching and expectant waiting expose surveillance as one strand of the condition being undone.
Guarding and keeping supply the retaining function that turns watchfulness into custody.

changed_reading.before: Freedom is a single change of legal status.
changed_reading.after: Freedom also requires taking apart the watch-and-guard system by which a person is kept capturable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Within the two focus roots, release of a pledge overlaps release of a neck, and رَقَبَة can also mark the core portion of property.
baseline_models.mechanism: The phrase exposes a conversion between body and asset: a human has been made collateral or property, and فَكّ extinguishes that proprietary claim. The result is not simply purchasing a new status but removing the person from the grammar of holdings.

activation_trace.role: The single release branch's overlap of pledge and captive supplies the collateral-to-person conversion.
Neck as whole bonded person keeps the economic model attached to an embodied human.
The core portion of property supplies the asset-register from which the person must be removed.

changed_reading.before: Release is an expense that changes who owns a person.
changed_reading.after: Release cancels the very claim by which an embodied person can function as collateral or core property.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ف ك ك inventory includes the jaws, and رَقَبَةٍ directly names the neck before extending to the person.
baseline_models.mechanism: Jaw and neck form a bodily articulation around speech, breath, and head movement. Their conjunction lets release image the reopening of a human bottleneck: agency is restored through an embodied articulation, not only through an abstract status.

activation_trace.role: The two jaws and their meeting points supply the movable articulation that can be opened.
Opening a lock or separating an interlace turns the anatomical contact into a release mechanism.
Neck as body part and whole captive person joins physical articulation to recovered human agency.

changed_reading.before: The phrase effects a juridical transfer out of bondage.
changed_reading.after: It can additionally image reopening the captive body's capacity for breath, speech, orientation, and self-directed action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated bounded place is paired with knot-loosening and dissolution of a prohibition before the focus repeats the opening operation on a person. Release therefore becomes a civic test: a city is not genuinely habitable merely because one may be present in it; its social knots must cease to hold persons.

activation_trace.role: Opening a lock and separating an interlace supplies the civic unbinding operation.
The neck as a whole bonded person makes the bounded city's ethical problem human rather than merely spatial.
A delimited tract supplies the containing civic boundary within which release must occur.
Dwelling and remaining in the city turn the boundary from scenery into a durable social order.
Untying a knot prefigures the focus's more concrete unfastening of a person.
Dissolution of a prohibition supplies the legal register in which a city's permissions can be revised.

structural_cues: 90:1 and 90:2 repeat the city noun around the addressee.
The context places the unbinding root inside the bounded place well before the focus applies an opening root to a person.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bounded habitation, knot-loosening, dissolved prohibition, and release of a person; I infer that civic legitimacy is measured by whether its order unbinds persons. A live alternative is that the earlier legal-spatial language concerns only the addressee's status and does not prescribe a civic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Freeing a person is a private transaction performed inside a city.
changed_reading.after: Freeing a person becomes the operation by which a bounded civic order is made genuinely open and habitable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ability and ownership culminate in a boast of exhausting wealth amassed layer upon layer. The focus's overlap of pledge, captive, person, and property then changes the accounting: wealth has not truly been expended merely by disappearing; it is converted when it extinguishes a claim over an embodied person.

activation_trace.role: Freeing both pledge and captive supplies the discharge operation by which wealth can terminate a human claim.
The neck as whole bonded person fixes the endpoint of the expenditure in a human life.
The core portion of property exposes the asset logic that can absorb a person.
Effective power reaching action and possession supplies the capacity whose use is being tested.
Exhausting and using up effort supplies the boast that something valuable has been consumed.
Acquiring and multiplying wealth supplies the stock of convertible power.
Material layered upon itself gives accumulation a concrete piled structure that release must break open.

structural_cues: 90:5-7 surround the wealth boast with questions about power and being seen.
90:6 presents wealth as a piled mass, while 90:13 presents release as a terse nominal act.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies possession-capacity, claimed consumption, piled wealth, pledge-release, and the person/property overlap; I infer that release is the criterion distinguishing ethical conversion from spectacular depletion. The alternative is that the boast concerns waste or hypocrisy without any specific collateral mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Release is one costly use among many possible uses of wealth.
changed_reading.after: Release is the conversion test that breaks piled capital open and removes a human body from its balance sheet.

context_deltas.mechanism: Eyes, tongue, and lips form a deliberate facial sequence; the focus inventories then add jaws and neck. Read together, the body is not an inert object transferred between owners: liberation rearticulates a perceptive and speaking person whose public agency had been constricted.

activation_trace.role: The jaws supply the mobile oral hinge that extends the earlier facial-organ sequence.
The neck as both body part and whole person connects anatomy to the captive's recovered agency.
The seeing eye supplies perceptive agency rather than a merely owned body.
The tongue as organ of speech supplies the capacity whose exercise an opened jaw enables.
Speech passing from lip to lip makes restored articulation social and publicly transmissible.

structural_cues: 90:8-9 enumerate paired eyes and paired lips around a single tongue.
The facial sequence precedes guidance and the difficult passage, while the focus returns to the adjacent jaw-neck anatomy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the organ sequence and the jaw/neck branches; I infer that those endowed capacities illuminate what personhood is restored by release. A live alternative is that the organs belong only to the accountable liberator, so applying their agency to the released person is a deliberate relational extension.

changed_reading.before: A legally classified body is transferred out of bondage.
changed_reading.after: A seeing and speaking person is rearticulated into public agency; liberation opens voice as well as status.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance to a path, the split root's branch-distant steep descent, elevation and hardship, entry into perilous terrain, and the twice-named difficult rise all converge on a choke-point. The focus supplies the operation that breaches it: opening the human lock by releasing the person is not a reward beyond the ascent but the ascent itself.

activation_trace.role: Opening a lock and separating an interlace supplies the operation that makes passage through a choke-point possible.
The whole bonded person is the concrete obstruction whose release constitutes the passage.
Gentle indication toward a path supplies the directional frame for the coming ascent.
The non-dominant mapped branch's steep descent makes the guided terrain unstable and difficult rather than flat.
Elevation and height supply the visible rise that must be negotiated.
Hardship and distress turn topography into an experienced social difficulty.
Perils and difficult stretches of road supply the forceful entry required at the obstacle.
The first difficult protruding ascent establishes the obstacle as steep terrain.
Knowledge and recognition make identifying the true breach part of the mechanism.
The repeated difficult rise holds the obstacle open as a question immediately before the focus answers it.

structural_cues: 90:10 presents two elevations, 90:11 negates entry into the obstacle, and 90:12 repeats the obstacle as a question.
The terse nominal phrase in 90:13 arrives immediately as the first specification of what the obstacle is.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies path, height, peril, repeated steepness, recognition, and opening-release; I infer the arrow that releasing the person is itself the breach through the terrain. A live alternative is that the terrain is only a generic metaphor and release is one item encountered after it.

changed_reading.before: Freeing a person is one meritorious act listed beyond a difficult moral climb.
changed_reading.after: Freeing the person is the concrete breach of the climb: the social lock is the difficult terrain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The coordinate movement from release to feeding in a crisis identifies forms of captivity that grip embodied survival: exhausting hunger, loss of a guardian, humiliating poverty, and adhesion to dust. Formal manumission remains live, but the neck now gathers the vulnerable life whose material and social restraints must also be loosened.

activation_trace.role: Release from closure and bondage supplies the governing de-capturing operation.
The neck as whole person lets later material constraints bear on an embodied life without erasing literal bondage.
Feeding another supplies the positive material act that loosens hunger's hold.
A day's severe event turns feeding from routine charity into intervention at a crisis point.
Hunger compounded by fatigue supplies a bodily restraint that can capture action and endurance.
A child cut off from a sustaining guardian supplies social severance as another form of exposure.
Kinship supplies a nearby obligation that counters the orphan's loss of protective relation.
The abasement of poverty supplies a social force that immobilizes and diminishes the person.
Poverty figured as sticking to dust gives material adhesion to the constraint release must overcome.

structural_cues: 90:13 and 90:14 are adjacent nominal acts under the answer to the obstacle question.
90:15-16 specify exposed recipients through lost guardianship, kinship, poverty, and dust.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies release, feeding, crisis-hunger, severed care, kinship, and dust-bound poverty; I infer that adjacency makes the acts mutually interpretive, expanding bondage into survival constraints while retaining literal manumission. The alternative is a list of independent good deeds with no shared de-capturing mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus ends one formally recognized bondage relation.
changed_reading.after: The focus becomes the first instance of a broader but still embodied release practice that also breaks hunger, care-loss, and poverty's grip.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus severs a coercive bond, but the later sequence supplies secure trust, reciprocal counsel, sustained bearing, mercy, and companionship. Release is therefore not social atomization: one binding is undone so that a non-possessive, mutually maintained belonging can form.

activation_trace.role: Separation or departure from a state supplies the necessary negative movement out of bondage.
The neck as whole person ensures that the one entering fellowship is a subject rather than a detached status.
Security and settled trust supply the non-coercive condition into which release can open.
Exchanged counsel among a group supplies reciprocity rather than one-directional ownership or patronage.
Bearing a guarantee and remaining with it supply durable support after the moment of severance.
Tender mercy supplies the affective rule of the replacement relation.
Companionship and sustained association supply a social destination for the released person.

structural_cues: 90:17 begins with a sequential transition and repeats a reciprocal verb for patience and mercy.
90:18 names a company immediately after the reciprocal practices.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies severance, security, reciprocal counsel, durable bearing, mercy, and companionship; I infer that freedom from coercion is completed by freedom into non-possessive belonging. A live alternative is that the later traits describe only the liberators' community and not the released person's social destination.

changed_reading.before: Release is complete when the coercive tie is cut.
changed_reading.after: Release cuts the coercive tie and opens the whole person into secure, reciprocal, merciful fellowship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus opens what is closed around a person. The ending moves through covering a visible sign to a burning enclosure sealed shut by both mapped closing branches. This creates a reversal: refusal of the anti-enclosure act culminates in enclosure turning back upon the refusing subject.

activation_trace.role: Opening what is locked supplies the positive anti-enclosure operation.
The whole captive person supplies the one around whom closure is first reversed.
Covering and concealment supply the cognitive-moral counterpart to physical closure.
A manifest sign supplies what remains visible despite the attempted covering.
Kindled fire supplies the active force contained inside the final enclosure.
Closing something upon what it contains supplies the dominant mapped image of total enclosure.
Sealing a door firmly supplies the non-dominant mapped image of an exit made inaccessible.

structural_cues: 90:19 opposes response to visible signs before 90:20 closes fire over its subjects.
The final predication places the enclosure upon them, reversing the focus's opening performed for another person.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opening, covering, visible sign, fire, and two independently mapped images of sealing; I infer the directional reversal that rejected opening returns as enclosure. The alternative is that the final seal is solely punitive imagery and does not echo the focus operation.

changed_reading.before: Freeing a person is an isolated positive act, and the final enclosure is a separate consequence.
changed_reading.after: Freeing a person is the surah's anti-enclosure axis: one either opens the human lock or participates in a logic of covering that ends sealed upon oneself.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from an animal loosening-near-birth branch into human generation and womb imagery. It remains anchored in the focus's exact release root and neck-as-person, with parent-child, creation, and womb branches making a coherent emergence mechanism. Render it only as a secondary image of social birth, not as a claim that the focus lexically denotes childbirth.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus release root can image bodily loosening near parturition, while the neck branch retains the whole captive person who emerges.

activation_trace.role: Loosening in an animal near birth supplies the strange but concrete emergence image.
Neck as whole bonded person keeps the emergence image attached to human liberation.
The event of birth and delivery supplies the context's explicit generative transition.
Bringing a creature into existence turns release into the beginning of a newly possible social life.
The womb supplies the later container from which merciful social emergence is analogically modeled.

changed_reading.before: Manumission ends an owner's claim at a legal instant.
changed_reading.after: Manumission can be carried as a social birth in which a constrained person emerges into a newly creatable life.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the ر ق ب branch of a watcher who hangs back, including the animal held from crowded water, and maps it onto human hunger. It remains anchored through the focus's opening action and the later feeding crisis, yielding a precise access-blockage mechanism. Render it as a material analogy for exclusion from vital resources, never as a zoological gloss of رَقَبَةٍ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines opening an interlace with a neck-root branch of delayed, watchful access.

activation_trace.role: Separating an interlaced blockage supplies the act of clearing access.
The watcher who waits or holds back at crowded access supplies the vulnerable position at the resource edge.
Feeding another supplies admission to the life-sustaining resource.
Hunger with exhaustion supplies the consequence of prolonged exclusion.
Abasing poverty identifies the human population structurally made to wait at the edge.

changed_reading.before: Release changes a person's formal title while resource distribution remains a later issue.
changed_reading.after: Release can also mean clearing the congested social gate that keeps a vulnerable person waiting outside food and other vital resources.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the proper-name astral branch of ف ك ك, whose round cluster is also scoped as the bowl of the poor, and lets later feeding and dust-poverty illuminate it. It remains anchored in an attested focus-root branch and produces a coherent shared-provision image. Render it only as poetic latent activation, not as the lexical sense of فَكُّ in the construction.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The exact focus root carries an obscure round-star-cluster branch whose scope names a bowl associated with the poor.

activation_trace.role: The round astral cluster, scoped as the bowl of the poor, supplies a communal vessel and constellation image.
Neck as whole person keeps the astral-vessel image directed toward actual human release.
Feeding another turns the bowl image into a shared provisioning practice.
Abasing poverty supplies the vulnerable community gathered by the image.
Poverty adhering to dust grounds the celestial cluster in material deprivation.

changed_reading.before: Release is a one-to-one legal intervention.
changed_reading.after: A poetic branch projects release as opening a shared bowl for the poor, a whole constellation of provisioning persons rather than an isolated transaction.

strongest_changes: The difficult ascent became a social choke-point whose actual breach is releasing the person.
Piled wealth became ethically converted only when it extinguishes the property claim over an embodied human.
The adjacent feeding, orphan, kinship, poverty, and dust cues expanded bondage into material survival constraints without displacing literal manumission.
Release changed from pure severance into movement toward secure, reciprocal, merciful companionship.
The final sealed enclosure reversed the focus's opening operation, making anti-enclosure a structural axis.
summary.what_was_special: The two-word focus held unusually productive crossings: opening, pledge-release, jaw, and an obscure poor-persons' bowl met neck, person, surveillance, property, and delayed access. Ordered context then made these branches causal rather than topical—wealth converts, terrain is breached, voice reopens, hunger's grip loosens, fellowship receives, and rejected opening returns as a seal. The direct manumission reading remains strongest, but it coexists with rather than absorbs these mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: The degree to which surveillance and property branches describe the bondage mechanism itself rather than merely echoing it remains open.
The public-voice model depends on assigning the earlier organ sequence to the released person's restored agency as well as to the accountable actor.
The adjacency of release and feeding may encode one de-capturing mechanism or may simply coordinate distinct difficult acts.
The social-birth, resource-queue, and bowl-of-the-poor readings are deliberately contained analogical activations, not proposed lexical replacements.
The final seal may reverse the focus's opening logic, or it may remain an independent consequence whose verbal contrast is only resonant.
